''Fancylojban'' (a [[jvocmevla]] from '''fancu '''(function) and '''lojban''') is a set of small additions made to Lojban to facilitate equational reasoning and the expression of complex functions. It sprang into being during the shift to ''functional '''ka''''', in which '''''ka'''''-abstractions are taken to create [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lambda_calculus lambda functions], as a way to explain the workings of this new kind of abstraction and its applications to the [[formal interpretation of tanru]] the thus [[definition of lujvo]], via the [[flipping principle]], and more generally to the [[axiomatic definition of Lojban]].

There certain essential precepts of fancylojban, which themselves form an interpretation for the term ''lojbanic''.

* <u>Compositionality</u>:  more complex structures should be built up from the composition of smaller ones,
* <u>Transparency</u>:  expressions that have the same referent are interchangeable,
* <u>Consistency</u>:  Lojban is a logical language; fancylojban aims to make this obvious,
* <u>Precision</u>:  the principle that ''[[Principle of least effort|the more you say, the more you mean]]'', i.e. that verbosity should be proportional to semantic content to the fullest extent possible and that the degree of precision of statement is left up to the speaker to choose.
